title: RTX 5090, Mac Studio, or DGX Spark? I tried all three.
cleaned_content: This video offers a practical comparison of RTX 5090, Mac Studio, and DGX Spark for AI/ML workloads. It aims to guide engineers in making informed infrastructure decisions based on cost-performance trade-offs for local or small-scale model training and inference. The key takeaway is understanding which hardware configuration best suits specific budget and performance requirements.
